questions.question: Which property aligns flex items along the Main Axis of the container?
questions.hint: justify-content aligns along the main axis.
questions.explanation: justify-content always aligns and distributes flex items along the main axis.

questions.question: When flex-direction: column is declared, which axis runs vertically from top to bottom?
questions.hint: flex-direction sets the Main Axis direction.
questions.explanation: flex-direction defines the main axis; setting it to column points the main axis vertically from top to bottom.

questions.question: Which shorthand declaration makes all flex children expand equally to share the available row space?
questions.explanation: flex: 1 (shorthand for flex-grow: 1, flex-shrink: 1, flex-basis: 0%) causes items to divide space equally.

questions.question: Which property controls the spacing between items inside a flex container without requiring margins on children?
questions.explanation: The gap property defines the gutters between rows and columns in flex and grid containers.

questions.question: What is the default value of flex-direction if left unspecified?
questions.explanation: flex-direction defaults to 'row', laying out flex items horizontally from left to right.
